C1: The bell rang before the butler raised his hand.
C2: Supper knocked three times for collection.
C3: The children returned the ball with its eyes open.
C4: The dog stood for inspection. Its shadow stayed seated.
C5: One bottle served the entire shift. Still full.
C6: The guest collected his case. His reflection stayed on duty.
E1: The founder looked down. His shadow left the frame.
E2: Rain left the middle window by the top.
E3: The lift opened onto another wall of the same paper.
E4: The guest asked for a clean collar. Only the glass was stained.
E5: The coat reached across the landing for its owner.
E6: The runner drew breath after the corridor emptied.
